lines.text: Cross. You're in. Listen carefully, we don't have long.
I hear you, {general}. Where's my ride out?
A chopper, on the helipad. It won't wait for you. Miss it and you're on your own.
Three ways to the pad: through the main floor, over the roofs, or down through the tunnels. Every one ends at the chopper.
Tripwires raise the alert. Shoot an alarm box to bring it back down. Raise it and the stairs down to the tunnels seal.
Riflemen on every floor. Dogs, if they get nervous. Whatever happens, keep running.
Placeholder briefing ends here. Good luck, Cross. Get to the chopper.
